mapper.select: SELECT c.document_id, c.embedding_status, COUNT(*) AS chunk_count FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id AND d.version = c.version GROUP BY c.document_id, c.embedding_status

SELECT d.doc_type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_no) AS documents, COUNT(*) AS versions, SUM(d.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published, SUM(d.status = 'DRAFT') AS drafts, SUM(d.status = 'ARCHIVED') AS archived, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN c.indexed END), 0) AS indexed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN c.pending END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN c.failed END), 0) AS failed FROM knowledge_document d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT document_id, version, SUM(embedding_status = 'INDEXED') AS indexed, SUM(embedding_status = 'PENDING') AS pending, SUM(embedding_status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM knowledge_chunk GROUP BY document_id, version ) c ON c.document_id = d.id AND c.version = d.version GROUP BY d.doc_type ORDER BY d.doc_type

SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.version, c.heading, c.content, d.doc_type, d.department_id, d.doctor_id FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id AND d.version = c.version WHERE c.embedding_status <> 'INDEXED' AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.version, c.heading, c.content, d.doc_type, d.department_id, d.doctor_id FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id AND d.version = c.version WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND d.version = #{version} AND d.status = 'DRAFT' AND c.embedding_status <> 'INDEXED' ORDER BY c.chunk_no LIMIT 1
